name: CyRECS911 — NG911 Attack Technique Layer
description: Attack-centric technique layer. Tiles show technique names; click for technical attack details and link to response playbook.

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-IA-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Phishing → PSAP workstation compromise

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Social engineering delivers malware or steals credentials to gain an initial foothold in PSAP workstations and adjacent IT assets.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Lure (email/chat/file) → user interaction → payload execution or credential theft → workstation compromise → lateral movement to PSAP backend systems if segmentation is weak.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: PSAP; PSAP_WORKSTATIONS; IT_NETWORK

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Disrupts call-taking/dispatch operations and can enable follow-on ransomware or data theft.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.9 (PSAP): 'System Compromise via Malware or Ransomware' mitigations include network segmentation, backups, staff training, antivirus, phishing prevention.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-IA-01.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-IA-02

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Supply-chain compromise of NG911 component/update

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: A vendor or integrator component (firmware/software/update) is compromised and introduced into trusted NG911 environments.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Compromise vendor build/update pipeline or third-party library → trojanized but trusted update → deployment into ESInet/PSAP components → privileged execution and persistence.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: ESInet; NGCS; BCF; ESRP; ECRF; LIS; LVF; PSAP_BACKEND

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Stealthy compromise affecting multiple functional elements, enabling integrity/availability attacks across regions.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel (supplier risk referenced in report) and NG-SEC emphasis on assurance for critical functions and change control.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-IA-02.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-IA-03

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Legacy traffic injection via LNG (protocol conversion ingress)

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Spoofed or malformed legacy signaling is translated through LNG and enters NG911 SIP paths when edge security is insufficient.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Craft hostile legacy call signaling → LNG translation into SIP → injected/misinterpreted call setup → misrouting or overload; can enable spoofing/TDoS at NG ingress.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LNG; LPG; ESInet

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Dropped/misrouted calls and injected fake calls that overload routing and PSAP operations.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.7 (LNG): 'Legacy Traffic Injection via Insufficient Security Controls' mitigations include endpoint whitelisting and STIR/SHAKEN where applicable.

metadata.name: Playbook

techniques.comment: Legacy traffic injection via LNG (protocol conversion ingress)

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-ID-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Caller identity spoofing in SIP signaling

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Manipulation of SIP identity-related fields to spoof caller identity, evade simple filtering, or support malicious call campaigns.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Forge/alter SIP From/P-Asserted-Identity/Contact and related headers → exploit weak ingress validation → calls appear to originate from trusted identities or geographies.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: BCF; ESRP; PSAP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Enables swatting/misdirection, increases TDoS effectiveness, and erodes trust in call attribution.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.6 (ESRP): 'Signaling Spoofing & Call Interception' mitigations include enforcing TLS with mutual authentication, validating certificates, and STIR/SHAKEN where applicable.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-ID-01.md

techniques.comment: Caller identity spoofing in SIP signaling

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-ID-02

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: LIS impersonation / spoofed location service

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Impersonation of LIS or submission of forged location assertions to influence routing and dispatch decisions.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Spoof LIS endpoint or return forged PIDF-LO/location objects → downstream components accept without strong authentication → misrouting/dispatch to incorrect locations.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LIS; LVF; ECRF; PSAP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Misdirected responders, routing errors, and potential public safety harm.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.1 (LIS): 'Impersonation of LIS (Spoofed Service)' mitigations include mutual TLS and validating endpoints with digital certificates.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-ID-02.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-PA-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Weak transport configuration / downgrade opportunity

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Inconsistent or weak transport security settings allow interception, manipulation, or trust bypass between NG911 services.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Exploit endpoints that allow weak protocol/cipher negotiation or inconsistent certificate validation → intercept/modify signaling and queries.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: ALL_ESINET_SERVICES

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Confidentiality loss of call metadata/location and integrity risks to routing/validation decisions.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.6 (ESRP) highlights TLS mutual authentication and certificate validation; NG-SEC discusses secure transport expectations for NG9-1-1 service interfaces.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-PA-01.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-PA-02

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Unsecured RTP bridging / media path compromise

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Interception or injection of call media where RTP is bridged/relayed without SRTP/SRTCP protections.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Exploit unsecured RTP relays or media gateways → eavesdrop, inject audio/media, or tamper with recordings/logging pipelines.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LPG; PSAP; LOGGING_SERVICE

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Privacy compromise and misleading/incomplete call content that can delay or misdirect response.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.8 (LPG): 'Unsecured RTP Bridging & Media Path Compromise' mitigations include TLS for SIP, SRTP/SRTCP, access controls, encryption in transit.

metadata.name: Playbook

techniques.comment: Unsecured RTP bridging / media path compromise

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-CO-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Exfiltrate caller location or call logs

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Unauthorized extraction of sensitive datasets (location, call records, incident logs) from LIS/PSAP/logging services.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Access data stores or log exports → stage internally → transfer to external destinations using allowed egress or covert channels.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LIS; PSAP_BACKEND; LOGGING_SERVICE

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Privacy violations, operational security exposure, and targeting risk for callers/responders.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.9 (PSAP): 'Unauthorized Access & Data Breaches' mitigations include RBAC, MFA, audit logging, vulnerability assessments.

techniques.comment: Exfiltrate caller location or call logs

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-DM-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: GIS/LVF dataset poisoning (validation corruption)

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Tampering with GIS/LVF datasets or validation logic to cause incorrect address validation and routing outcomes.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Modify GIS records/versioned datasets → LVF returns incorrect validation results → misrouting or dispatch delays; may evade detection without integrity controls.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LVF; ECRF; PRF

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Dispatch routing errors, delayed response, and swatting-like outcomes.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.2 (LVF): 'GIS Data Tampering & Address Validation Corruption' mitigations include access control to GIS data, version management, integrity validation.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-DM-01.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-DM-02

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: LIS location tampering / bogus location insertion

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Modification or insertion of fraudulent location records that downstream routing components treat as authoritative.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Alter legitimate location records or inject fake caller location → routing/validation consumes bad data → responders dispatched incorrectly.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LIS; ECRF; PSAP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Misdirected responders and delayed emergency response; public trust degradation.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.1 (LIS): 'Location Tampering' mitigations include integrity checks, encryption, and digital signatures for location updates.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-DM-02.md

techniques.comment: LIS location tampering / bogus location insertion

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-SD-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Telephone Denial of Service (TDoS) against PSAP

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: High-volume fake calls overwhelm PSAP queues and staffing, preventing legitimate emergency callers from being answered.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Auto-dialers/botnets generate call floods (voice/text/video) → queues saturate → legitimate calls delayed/dropped.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: PSAP; BCF; ESRP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Legitimate emergencies blocked; severe public safety consequences during peak events.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.9 (PSAP): 'Telephone Denial of Service (TDoS)' mitigations include suspicious call tagging, STIR/SHAKEN where applicable, call filtering, dynamic rate-limiting.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-SD-01.md

techniques.comment: Telephone Denial of Service (TDoS) against PSAP

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-SD-02

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: SIP-based DDoS/call flooding targeting ESRP

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Flooding ESRP with SIP signaling exhausts processing and disrupts call routing for legitimate emergencies.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Burst INVITE/OPTIONS/registration storms → ESRP CPU/memory exhaustion → routing lookups delayed or fail; failover may cascade.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: ESRP; BCF; PSAP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Delayed or failed routing decisions; cascading failures across redundant nodes if not protected.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.6 (ESRP): 'Call Flooding via SIP-Based DDoS' mitigations include SIP-aware rate limiting/anomaly detection and redundant ESRP nodes with load balancing.

metadata.name: Playbook
metadata.value: CR-SD-02.md

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-SD-03

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: DoS-induced isolation of legacy PSAPs (LPG failure)

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Attacks or failures at LPG disrupt gateway connectivity, isolating legacy PSAPs that depend on gateway paths.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: DoS against LPG or upstream congestion → gateway becomes unreachable → legacy PSAP cannot receive routed calls; fallback paths may be insufficient.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: LPG; LNG; PSAP

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Regions lose emergency access for legacy-connected PSAPs; prolonged outages without redundancy.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.8 (LPG): 'DoS-Induced Isolation of Legacy PSAPs' mitigations include redundant LPGs and traffic filtering.

metadata.name: Playbook

techniques.comment: DoS-induced isolation of legacy PSAPs (LPG failure)

metadata.name: CyRECS ID
metadata.value: CR-IM-01

metadata.name: Display Name
metadata.value: Ransomware targeting PSAP operations

metadata.name: Attack Overview
metadata.value: Encryption or lockout of PSAP workstations/servers to halt dispatch/call-handling operations.

metadata.name: How it works
metadata.value: Initial compromise (often phishing) → spread to file shares/servers → encryption/lockout → operational disruption and recovery pressure.

metadata.name: Affected elements
metadata.value: PSAP; PSAP_WORKSTATIONS; IT_NETWORK

metadata.name: Operational impact
metadata.value: Severe service interruption; forced manual operations; degraded response times and public trust.

metadata.name: Sources
metadata.value: ThreatModel Table 6.2.9 (PSAP): 'System Compromise via Malware or Ransomware' mitigations include network segmentation, backups, staff training, antivirus, phishing prevention.
